This engagement takes place between the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] (which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]) and the beginning of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] (which can be dated to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:Xwing 1BBY|here]]).
